title: PES 0110 writes a hole sewing pair as PE-DESIGN's paired objects
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes a hole sewing pair as PE-DESIGN 11.50 writes Modify Overlap > Set hole sewing: the inner shape Not Sewn and the pair [outer, inner] in the sixteen bytes before the group list (owner files concentric-ring40-hole15 and spiral-ring40-hole15, compat/reference/stitches). The design is those files' rings with a Fill region: a 15 mm circle inside a 40 mm one, both centred on (50,50) mm, the outer one sewn as Fill in Red around the inner one, which is not sewn.

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, PES 0110 object list, hole sewing: mapped from the owner's concentric-ring40-hole15, spiral-ring40-hole15 and hole-sewing-pentagon-star; the writer's rewrite of those files is byte-identical outside the documented differences (pes11.rs, written_object_sections_match_pe_designs_bytes_outside_the_documented_differences)

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-hole-sewing` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-hole-sewing/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open). Expected: a 40 mm circle sewn as Fill Stitch in Red around a 15 mm circle that is not sewn, both centred on (50,50) mm, as the owner's ring files: Home > Modify Overlap > Hole sewing shows Cancel hole sewing enabled with the outer circle selected, and the fill leaves the inner circle empty. Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether the file opens and with what warning, whether the hole sewing pair is recognised (Cancel hole sewing enabled), and the status-bar size and stitch count. Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.
